_readme: Copy this file to data/api_keys.json and fill in your own keys. data/ is git-ignored, so it is never committed. The more of the four job-board sources you fill in, the wider the coverage (rapidapi_key in particular reaches LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor).
_adzuna: Free sign-up at https://developer.adzuna.com/ gives an app_id + app_key (free tier has a monthly call quota)
_reed: Free sign-up at https://www.reed.co.uk/developers gives an API key
_jooble: Free sign-up at https://jooble.org/api/about gives a key; aggregates many UK job sites
_rapidapi: Subscribe to JSearch at https://rapidapi.com/letscrape-6bRBa3QguO5/api/jsearch (has a free tier) and copy your X-RapidAPI-Key. It pulls Google for Jobs, covering LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor - the biggest blind spot of the tool's own hiring-system scan
_resume_tips: Add one LLM key to generate resume tips in the tool: openai_api_key for ChatGPT or anthropic_api_key for Claude. If both are set, choose with llm_provider (openai / anthropic); if unset, ChatGPT is used first. The OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variables also work.
